notes: Stuck-turn safety net: (1) new always-visible ⏭ Pass button in the action panel — discards the current card and ends the player's turn, routed through the normal MP turn-advance broadcast so multiplayer stays in sync; (2) stuck-turn watchdog polls every 2s and auto-passes after ~12s when the active human player has no legal moves and the End-Turn hint failed to surface. Implements rules.json CARD_NO_LEGAL_MOVE (discard card, end turn, no extra-turn award) as an unconditional escape hatch so the game can never freeze on a wedged turn.
